column1: # Evidence ledger (2026-11-16): the cumulative byte-identity list. Every row is re-checked by env/tools/ledger_check.sh after every build.
# Columns: id, kind, method, list, root, local, verified_copy, remote, published, note.
#   method sha256c: (cd root && sha256sum -c list); list is relative to the research directory or absolute.
#   method parts: (cd root && sha256sum -c PARTS.sha256) for a bundle directory.
#   The four states are kept apart: local = the bytes are on this machine; verified_copy = a second copy checked by stream
#   (bundle or xz copy, where); remote = a copy outside this machine (none yet: nothing is pushed); published = in the public repository.
